name: Golf (Six Card)
description: Six-Card Golf is a matching game where players try to earn the lowest score over nine holes (rounds). Each player manages a six-card layout arranged in a 2x3 grid, replacing high cards with lower ones drawn from the stock or discard pile. The game's unique strategy involves balancing point reduction with the need to match cards in columns to nullify their scores.

content.text: Six-Card Golf is a matching game where players try to earn the lowest score over nine holes (rounds). Each player manages a six-card layout arranged in a 2x3 grid, replacing high cards with lower ones drawn from the stock or discard pile. The game's unique strategy involves balancing point reduction with the need to match cards in columns to nullify their scores.
Derived from the basic four-card version of Golf, the six-card variant became significantly more popular due to the added depth of the 2x3 layout and column-matching rules.
Standard 52-card deck. For more than 4 players, two decks may be shuffled together.

Dealer deals 6 cards to each player, face-down, in a 2x3 layout. Remaining cards form the stock. Top card of stock is turned face-up to start the discard pile. Players turn any two of their own cards face-up at the start.

items.text: Nine-Card Golf: Played with a 3x3 grid (9 cards). Column matching only works for three-of-a-kind.
Harakiri: A variant where 'Knocking' carries a penalty if the knocker doesn't have the lowest score.
